heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 103–82, title III, § 346, Sept. 21, 1993, 107 Stat. 905

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 93–113, title II, § 212, Oct. 1, 1973, 87 Stat. 402; Pub. L. 94–135, title II, § 205(b)(3), Nov. 28, 1975, 89 Stat. 727; Pub.
